in_marathi.name: Edul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Edul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Edul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ved', which means 'knowledge'. It is also associated with the Tamil word 'Edul', which means 'learning'. This name is bestowed upon a child to inspire a thirst for knowledge and wisdom, and to encourage them to become lifelong learners.
